title: Branching on the first wide residual clause with an adaptive width budget
claims: SmallWeakBackdoorResidualWidthSATInP bounds the search by the widths of first wide residual clauses under restrictions of a satisfying weak backdoor.
ResidualWidthBudgetSeparation exhibits an unbounded-width family that satisfies the new condition and fails the original-maximum-width sufficient condition at the same budget.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.
